paragraphs.source_en: It was in the latter part of the ninth month of the nineteenth year of Keichō that Tokugawa Ieyasu decided to march against Osaka. Until then, he had continued to hope that some other means might be found to resolve the crisis. The greatest reason for his long hesitation, however, remained the state of his own health.

paragraphs.source_en: Yet even with war imminent, Ieyasu still felt uneasy about the shogun, Hidetada. He did not fear defeat; he feared only that soaring morale would lead to excessive slaughter. Victory and defeat in war always drove the roots of resentment deep into the earth. If the killing went too far, that resentment would pass from generation to generation and one day bring misfortune from an unexpected quarter.

units.source_en: Through this campaign, Ieyasu intended to test the loyalty of the Date, Uesugi, and Satake houses to the shogunate.
units.source_zh: 家康想通过此次出征，考查伊达、上杉、佐竹诸氏对幕府忠心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此次主力乃是东北诸藩。家康想通过此次出征，考查伊达、上杉、佐竹诸氏对幕府忠心。

paragraphs.source_en: On the tenth, Ieyasu received the daimyos who had hastened to Sunpu; on the eleventh, he departed.

units.source_en: On the tenth, Ieyasu received the daimyos who had hastened to Sunpu; on the eleventh, he departed.
units.source_zh: 初十，家康接见赶往骏府的诸大名，十一日，家康出发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 初十，家康接见赶往骏府的诸大名，十一日，家康出发。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah, who else under heaven but I, Tokugawa Ieyasu, would lead the sons and grandsons of others onto the battlefield after passing seventy!” It was, without question, a lament from the depths of his heart.

units.source_en: “Ah, who else under heaven but I, Tokugawa Ieyasu, would lead the sons and grandsons of others onto the battlefield after passing seventy!”
units.source_zh: “唉，年逾七十还要统领众人子孙，征战沙场，普天之下唯我德川家康啊！”

units.source_en: It was, without question, a lament from the depths of his heart.
units.source_zh: 这无疑为由衷的感慨。

paragraphs.source_zh: “唉，年逾七十还要统领众人子孙，征战沙场，普天之下唯我德川家康啊！”这无疑为由衷的感慨。

paragraphs.source_en: Once outside Sunpu Castle, however, Ieyasu showed little haste. He reached Kakegawa on the twelfth and Nakaizumi on the thirteenth, traveling at a decidedly leisurely pace.

units.source_en: Once outside Sunpu Castle, however, Ieyasu showed little haste. He reached Kakegawa on the twelfth and Nakaizumi on the thirteenth, traveling at a decidedly leisurely pace.
units.source_zh: 但出了骏府城，家康并不甚急，十二日行至悬川，十三日抵中泉，一路颇为悠闲。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但出了骏府城，家康并不甚急，十二日行至悬川，十三日抵中泉，一路颇为悠闲。

paragraphs.source_en: As Ieyasu advanced westward, Hidetada also volunteered to take the field.

units.source_en: As Ieyasu advanced westward, Hidetada also volunteered to take the field.
units.source_zh: 随着家康西进，秀忠亦主动提出要出征。

paragraphs.source_zh: 随着家康西进，秀忠亦主动提出要出征。

paragraphs.source_en: Even before Ieyasu departed, Hidetada had specially sent Doi Toshikatsu to Sunpu with this message: “For this campaign, I beg you to send your son and remain in command at Edo, Father.”

units.source_en: Even before Ieyasu departed, Hidetada had specially sent Doi Toshikatsu to Sunpu with this message: “For this campaign, I beg you to send your son and remain in command at Edo, Father.”
units.source_zh: 早在家康出发之前，秀忠就特意派土井利胜至骏府，道：“此次征伐，希望能派孩儿去，请父亲坐镇江户。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 早在家康出发之前，秀忠就特意派土井利胜至骏府，道：“此次征伐，希望能派孩儿去，请父亲坐镇江户。”

paragraphs.source_en: Doi Toshikatsu knew that behind these words lay an aged father's concern. But since the defense of Sunpu had been entrusted to the merely twelve-year-old Yorifusa, should not Shogun Hidetada likewise leave Edo in the care of Matsudaira Tadateru? At the time, rumors were widespread that the shogun and Tadateru still remained at odds. Perhaps Ieyasu hoped to use this campaign to lay those rumors to rest.

units.source_en: Doi Toshikatsu knew that behind these words lay an aged father's concern.
units.source_zh: 土井利胜知此言中藏着一个老父的挂虑。

units.source_en: But since the defense of Sunpu had been entrusted to the merely twelve-year-old Yorifusa, should not Shogun Hidetada likewise leave Edo in the care of Matsudaira Tadateru?
units.source_zh: 但骏府留守交与年仅十二的赖房，将军秀忠是否亦应把江户的留守交与松平忠辉？

units.source_en: At the time, rumors were widespread that the shogun and Tadateru still remained at odds. Perhaps Ieyasu hoped to use this campaign to lay those rumors to rest.

ja.t: めようとしたのかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 此际世间盛传，将军与忠辉仍是不和，许是家康希望能借此次出征平息流言。

paragraphs.source_zh: 土井利胜知此言中藏着一个老父的挂虑。但骏府留守交与年仅十二的赖房，将军秀忠是否亦应把江户的留守交与松平忠辉？此际世间盛传，将军与忠辉仍是不和，许是家康希望能借此次出征平息流言。

paragraphs.source_en: Accordingly, following Shogun Hidetada's design, Doi Toshikatsu replied that Edo would be entrusted to Matsudaira Tadateru, assisted by Okudaira Iemasa, Mogami Iechika, and Torii Tadamasa.

units.source_en: Accordingly, following Shogun Hidetada's design, Doi Toshikatsu replied that Edo would be entrusted to Matsudaira Tadateru, assisted by Okudaira Iemasa, Mogami Iechika, and Torii Tadamasa.
units.source_zh: 于是，土井利胜依将军秀忠的打算，回道：江户留守交与松平忠辉，由奥平家昌、最上家亲、鸟居忠政辅佐。

paragraphs.source_zh: 于是，土井利胜依将军秀忠的打算，回道：江户留守交与松平忠辉，由奥平家昌、最上家亲、鸟居忠政辅佐。

paragraphs.source_en: Now Hidetada once again sent Matsudaira Shigenobu as an envoy to catch up with Ieyasu. He reported the arrangements in Edo and the news that Fukushima Masanori, Kuroda Nagamasa, Katō Yoshiaki, and others with deep ties to the Toyotomi house had agreed to remain there, while again asking Ieyasu's permission to take the field.

units.source_en: Now Hidetada once again sent Matsudaira Shigenobu as an envoy to catch up with Ieyasu. He reported the arrangements in Edo and the news that Fukushima Masanori, Kuroda Nagamasa, Katō Yoshiaki, and others with deep ties to the Toyotomi house had agreed to remain there, while again asking Ieyasu's permission to take the field.
units.source_zh: 今，秀忠再次派松平重信为使追来，通报江户安排，及与丰臣氏有着万千丝缕的福岛正则、黑田长政、加藤嘉明等人已答应留于江户的消息，同时，请求家康允他出征。

paragraphs.source_zh: 今，秀忠再次派松平重信为使追来，通报江户安排，及与丰臣氏有着万千丝缕的福岛正则、黑田长政、加藤嘉明等人已答应留于江户的消息，同时，请求家康允他出征。

paragraphs.source_en: “It is still too soon. There is no need to hurry.” Ieyasu rejected the request with the same composure and entered Hamamatsu Castle on the fourteenth.

units.source_en: “It is still too soon. There is no need to hurry.”
units.source_zh: “为时尚早，不必着急。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu rejected the request with the same composure and entered Hamamatsu Castle on the fourteenth.
units.source_zh: 家康同样淡然拒绝，并于十四日进入滨松城。

paragraphs.source_zh: “为时尚早，不必着急。”家康同样淡然拒绝，并于十四日进入滨松城。

paragraphs.source_en: At this time, Ieyasu ordered Terazawa Hirotaka of Karatsu and Hasegawa Fujihiro, the Nagasaki magistrate, to keep close watch on the movements of Christians throughout Kyushu. Word had also arrived that Ii Naokatsu, lord of Hikone Castle, was ill, and that his younger brother Naotaka had therefore led troops to guard Uji in Yamashiro.

units.source_en: At this time, Ieyasu ordered Terazawa Hirotaka of Karatsu and Hasegawa Fujihiro, the Nagasaki magistrate, to keep close watch on the movements of Christians throughout Kyushu.
units.source_zh: 此时，家康令唐津的寺泽广高与长崎奉行长谷川藤广，严密监视九州各地洋教徒的动向。

units.source_en: Word had also arrived that Ii Naokatsu, lord of Hikone Castle, was ill, and that his younger brother Naotaka had therefore led troops to guard Uji in Yamashiro.
units.source_zh: 彦根城主井伊直胜因病，由其弟直孝率兵把守山城宇治的消息也已传来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，家康令唐津的寺泽广高与长崎奉行长谷川藤广，严密监视九州各地洋教徒的动向。彦根城主井伊直胜因病，由其弟直孝率兵把守山城宇治的消息也已传来。

paragraphs.source_en: The moment Ieyasu's orders arrived, the commanders and soldiers sprang swiftly into action.

units.source_en: The moment Ieyasu's orders arrived, the commanders and soldiers sprang swiftly into action.
units.source_zh: 众将士一接家康命令，遂敏捷行动起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众将士一接家康命令，遂敏捷行动起来。

paragraphs.source_en: Tadanao, son of Hideyasu of Kitanoshō in Echizen, had already advanced toward Hashimoto near Yodo, moving with such speed that it seemed he had long been prepared.

units.source_en: Tadanao, son of Hideyasu of Kitanoshō in Echizen, had already advanced toward Hashimoto near Yodo, moving with such speed that it seemed he had long been prepared.
units.source_zh: 越前北庄秀康之子忠直已向淀桥本进军，动作神速，仿佛早已作好准备。

paragraphs.source_zh: 越前北庄秀康之子忠直已向淀桥本进军，动作神速，仿佛早已作好准备。

paragraphs.source_en: On the fifteenth day of the tenth month, Ieyasu's palanquin reached Yoshida. On the sixteenth, he arrived at Okazaki, the land of his past. Only upon reaching Okazaki did Ieyasu learn that his seventh son, Tokugawa Yoshinao, had been unable to wait for his arrival and had led his troops out of Nagoya ahead of time.

units.source_en: On the fifteenth day of the tenth month, Ieyasu's palanquin reached Yoshida.
units.source_zh: 十月十五，家康的轿舆至吉田。

units.source_en: On the sixteenth, he arrived at Okazaki, the land of his past.
units.source_zh: 十六，抵达故地冈崎。

units.source_en: Only upon reaching Okazaki did Ieyasu learn that his seventh son, Tokugawa Yoshinao, had been unable to wait for his arrival and had led his troops out of Nagoya ahead of time.
units.source_zh: 到达冈崎，家康才知七男德川义直已等不及他到来，提前率兵出了名古屋。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十月十五，家康的轿舆至吉田。十六，抵达故地冈崎。到达冈崎，家康才知七男德川义直已等不及他到来，提前率兵出了名古屋。

paragraphs.source_en: Though he said nothing aloud, this unexpectedly cast a shadow over Ieyasu's heart: perhaps Hideyori, like Tadanao and Yoshinao, also thought battle was exciting.

units.source_en: Though he said nothing aloud, this unexpectedly cast a shadow over Ieyasu's heart: perhaps Hideyori, like Tadanao and Yoshinao, also thought battle was exciting.

ja.t: さなかったが、このことは
っているのではないか。

units.source_zh: 尽管嘴上不曾明言，但这亦意外地在家康心头留下阴影：秀赖恐亦和忠直、义直一样，觉得战阵有趣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管嘴上不曾明言，但这亦意外地在家康心头留下阴影：秀赖恐亦和忠直、义直一样，觉得战阵有趣。

paragraphs.source_en: The younger generation did not know how dreadful war truly was. They had merely grown accustomed to hearing tales of valiant warriors and in truth knew nothing of the reality. The wretched cries, the despair, the hunger, and the reek of blood—they could neither smell them nor comprehend them.

units.source_en: The younger generation did not know how dreadful war truly was.
units.source_zh: 下一辈不知战争乃是何其惨烈。

units.source_en: They had merely grown accustomed to hearing tales of valiant warriors and in truth knew nothing of the reality.
units.source_zh: 他们只是听惯了勇猛的武家故事，对真相实则一无所知。

units.source_en: The wretched cries, the despair, the hunger, and the reek of blood—they could neither smell them nor comprehend them.
units.source_zh: 对于凄惨的叫唤、绝望、饥饿，以及血腥的味道，他们既嗅不到，也听不懂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 下一辈不知战争乃是何其惨烈。他们只是听惯了勇猛的武家故事，对真相实则一无所知。对于凄惨的叫唤、绝望、饥饿，以及血腥的味道，他们既嗅不到，也听不懂。

paragraphs.source_en: Tadateru, Yoshinao, Yorinobu, Yorifusa, Hideyori in Osaka Castle, and Tadanao, Hideyasu's son—not one of them understood Ieyasu's true intention. Yet at seventy-three, Ieyasu was compelled to lead these young men, possessed of valor but little else, out to discover the sorrow and joy of all creation.

units.source_en: Tadateru, Yoshinao, Yorinobu, Yorifusa, Hideyori in Osaka Castle, and Tadanao, Hideyasu's son—not one of them understood Ieyasu's true intention.
units.source_zh: 忠辉、义直、赖宣、赖房，以及大坂城之秀赖、秀康之子忠直，都对家康的真意一无所知。

units.source_en: Yet at seventy-three, Ieyasu was compelled to lead these young men, possessed of valor but little else, out to discover the sorrow and joy of all creation.

ja.t: らせねばならなかった。

units.source_zh: 但七十有三的家康，竟不得不带领这些徒有勇武的年轻后生去探知天地悲喜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠辉、义直、赖宣、赖房，以及大坂城之秀赖、秀康之子忠直，都对家康的真意一无所知。但七十有三的家康，竟不得不带领这些徒有勇武的年轻后生去探知天地悲喜。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu often found it strange. Life was truly beyond words—truly absurd. Whenever he thought of it, he wanted to laugh at himself. How could he not laugh? Here was Tokugawa Ieyasu, who had fought the fiercest warriors and scarcely ever lost, now compelled to wage a bloody war against mere youths. Was this fate?

units.source_en: Ieyasu often found it strange.
units.source_zh: 家康时时觉得奇怪。

units.source_en: Life was truly beyond words—truly absurd.

ja.t: にならぬもの、まことに

units.source_zh: 人生真是无以言喻，真是可笑。

units.source_en: Whenever he thought of it, he wanted to laugh at himself.
units.source_zh: 一想到这些，他就想自嘲自笑。

units.source_en: How could he not laugh?
units.source_zh: 他怎能不笑？

units.source_en: Here was Tokugawa Ieyasu, who had fought the fiercest warriors and scarcely ever lost, now compelled to wage a bloody war against mere youths. Was this fate?

units.source_zh: 无论和多么凶猛的武士决斗，几无败绩，这样的一个德川家康，现在竟不得不与年少儿郎展开一场血战，此乃命也？

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康时时觉得奇怪。人生真是无以言喻，真是可笑。一想到这些，他就想自嘲自笑。他怎能不笑？无论和多么凶猛的武士决斗，几无败绩，这样的一个德川家康，现在竟不得不与年少儿郎展开一场血战，此乃命也？

paragraphs.source_en: Yet if a single careless step allowed the situation to worsen, it would give rise to a tragedy under heaven that no one could contain. Even a lion hunting a hare must exert its full strength.

units.source_en: Yet if a single careless step allowed the situation to worsen, it would give rise to a tragedy under heaven that no one could contain.
units.source_zh: 可是，若一不小心，令事态恶化，必会酿成一场无法收拾的天地之悲。

units.source_en: Even a lion hunting a hare must exert its full strength.
units.source_zh: 即如狮子猎捕兔子，亦当付出全力。

paragraphs.source_zh: 可是，若一不小心，令事态恶化，必会酿成一场无法收拾的天地之悲。即如狮子猎捕兔子，亦当付出全力。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu himself reached Gifu on the nineteenth and Kashiwabara in Ōmi on the twentieth. There he received yet another report treating warfare like child's play: several rōnin carrying secret orders from Hideyori had been apprehended in Kyoto by Itakura Shigemune. Hideyori and his circle expected Ieyasu to enter Nijō Castle within days. They therefore devised a plan to set the castle ablaze and shoot Ieyasu amid the confusion, dispatching those rōnin into Kyoto for that purpose.

units.source_en: Ieyasu himself reached Gifu on the nineteenth and Kashiwabara in Ōmi on the twentieth. There he received yet another report treating warfare like child's play: several rōnin carrying secret orders from Hideyori had been apprehended in Kyoto by Itakura Shigemune.
units.source_zh: 家康自己则于十九日抵达岐阜，二十日抵近江柏原，此时，他再次接到一个视战阵如儿戏的消息：几个携秀赖密令的浪人，在京都被板仓胜重捉拿归案。

units.source_en: Hideyori and his circle expected Ieyasu to enter Nijō Castle within days. They therefore devised a plan to set the castle ablaze and shoot Ieyasu amid the confusion, dispatching those rōnin into Kyoto for that purpose.
units.source_zh: 秀赖等人预计家康不日后必进驻二条城，遂定了一个在二条城纵火、趁乱狙击家康的计划，将那些浪人派进了京都。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康自己则于十九日抵达岐阜，二十日抵近江柏原，此时，他再次接到一个视战阵如儿戏的消息：几个携秀赖密令的浪人，在京都被板仓胜重捉拿归案。秀赖等人预计家康不日后必进驻二条城，遂定了一个在二条城纵火、趁乱狙击家康的计划，将那些浪人派进了京都。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu could only smile bitterly. Only the day before, he had received a letter written in Hideyori's own hand and forwarded by Tokunaga Masashige, lord of Takasu Castle in Mino. The letter declared that Hideyori harbored no disloyal intent whatsoever toward Lord Ieyasu or the shogun. It had moved Ieyasu, if only slightly. But now it appeared to have been nothing more than a ruse to lower Ieyasu's guard and lure him into Nijō Castle.

units.source_en: Ieyasu could only smile bitterly.
units.source_zh: 家康不禁苦笑。

units.source_en: Only the day before, he had received a letter written in Hideyori's own hand and forwarded by Tokunaga Masashige, lord of Takasu Castle in Mino.
units.source_zh: 昨日，他还收到一封由美浓高须城主德永昌重转呈、由秀赖亲写的书函。

units.source_en: The letter declared that Hideyori harbored no disloyal intent whatsoever toward Lord Ieyasu or the shogun.
units.source_zh: 函上说，秀赖对家康公和将军绝无异心。

units.source_en: It had moved Ieyasu, if only slightly.
units.source_zh: 为此，家康还略微有些心动。

units.source_en: But now it appeared to have been nothing more than a ruse to lower Ieyasu's guard and lure him into Nijō Castle.

units.source_zh: 但现在看来，这只是一个让家康放松警惕、诱他入二条城的把戏。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康不禁苦笑。昨日，他还收到一封由美浓高须城主德永昌重转呈、由秀赖亲写的书函。函上说，秀赖对家康公和将军绝无异心。为此，家康还略微有些心动。但现在看来，这只是一个让家康放松警惕、诱他入二条城的把戏。
